title: Mine Island2

sourceFacts: The official MineIsland2 EASY demo shows ten ascending platforms from 1.1x to 100x. PLAY resolves a first jump; a successful first step can COLLECT 1.10 DMO from a 1.00 DMO stake.
unresolved: Medium and hard multipliers, boost/portal mechanics and survival probabilities remain independently authored or unverified.
